children: New Delhi, Oct. 14 -- Jio Platforms Limited, a subsidiary of Reliance Industries, has filed its Red Herring Prospectus (RHP) with the Registrar of Companies, on October 14, 2026, taking another key step towards its initial public offering (IPO).
The IPO will open for subscription on Wednesday, October 21, and close on Friday, October 23, 2026. The anchor investor bidding date has been scheduled for Monday, October 19.
The company had filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) on June 19, 2026, and received an observation letter from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on August 28, 2026.

The IPO, as outlined in the earlier DRHP, proposed a fresh issue of up to 27 crore equity shares with a face value of Rs.10 each. The final offer structure and other details should be checked against the RHP.
Jio Platforms has appointed 19 banks to manage the share sale, including Kotak Mahindra Capital Co., Morgan Stanley, Bank of America Corp., Axis Capital Ltd., BNP Paribas SA, and Citigroup Inc.

The issue includes a reservation of equity shares worth up to Rs.500 crore for eligible employees. It also provides for a reservation of shares worth up to Rs.2,500 crore for eligible shareholders of Reliance Industries.

Eligible Reliance Industries shareholders include individuals and Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs), either directly or through the karta, who held public equity shares of the company as of October 14, 2026, the date of filing of the RHP. The reservation is subject to applicable laws and eligibility conditions detailed in the prospectus.

title: Jio Platforms files RHP for IPO: Issue to open on October 21; fresh issue of up to 27 crore equity shares
